user_story: As a user, I want to filter tasks by completion status so that I can see only open or only done tasks.

positive.title: Filter tasks by completion status to show only open tasks
steps: Navigate to the task list page
positive.expected_result: Only tasks with open status are displayed

positive.title: Filter tasks by completion status to show only done tasks
steps: Navigate to the task list page
positive.expected_result: Only tasks with done status are displayed

positive.title: Toggle between open and done filter
steps: Navigate to the task list page
positive.expected_result: Initially only open tasks are displayed, then only done tasks are displayed

negative.title: Filter tasks by invalid status
steps: Navigate to the task list page
Attempt to filter by an invalid status option
negative.expected_result: No tasks are displayed or an error message is shown

negative.title: Filter tasks without an active status filter
steps: Navigate to the task list page
negative.expected_result: All tasks irrespective of their status are displayed

edge.title: Filter tasks when there are no tasks with the selected status
steps: Ensure no tasks have open status

edge.title: Filter tasks when all tasks have the same status
steps: Ensure all tasks are marked as done

edge.title: Filter tasks by extremely large task list
steps: Generate a large list of tasks with mixed statuses
edge.expected_result: Only done tasks are displayed, performance is not degraded
